properties.name: cost_hk
properties.description: Standard manufacturing/purchase cost (HK = Herstellkosten), from ERP std_kosten. The €-basis for scrap / quality impact.

properties.name: price_vk
properties.description: Standard sales price (VK = Verkaufspreis), from ERP std_verkaufspreis. The basis for margin / lost-sales impact. Null for non-sellable articles (RAW/CONSUMABLE/WIP).

properties.name: currency
properties.description: ISO-4217 currency code for cost_hk / price_vk, from ERP waehrung (e.g. EUR).

properties.name: stock_free
properties.description: Free (unblocked) stock of this article across all warehouses (menge_frei). Served by GET /api/articles, which is ARTICLE_WITH_STOCK_AND_PRICE_SQL. This is the article-level figure the WMS Quant rows sum to; a single Quant is one pallet/lot in one bin and is NOT a stock position.

properties.name: stock_reserved
properties.description: Quantity already committed to orders (menge_reserviert) — free stock that is spoken for.

properties.name: stock_blocked
properties.description: Quantity blocked / on hold (menge_blockiert).

properties.name: stock_available
properties.description: AVAILABLE-TO-PROMISE: free minus reserved (verfuegbar). Full text: docs/history/standard/profiles/material/article.md, attributes › stock_available › description.

properties.name: reorder_level
properties.description: Reorder level / Meldebestand from the ERP article master (mindestbestand). Full text: docs/history/standard/profiles/material/article.md, attributes › reorder_level › description.

properties.name: safety_stock
properties.description: Safety stock (safety_stock). Full text: docs/history/standard/profiles/material/article.md, attributes › safety_stock › description.

properties.name: material_class_ref
properties.description: The material class this article belongs to (DEFINED_BY), e.g. PA66-GF30. Empty until the article master or a mapping supplies it.

properties.name: assembly_type
properties.description: ISA-95 AssemblyType: Physical (the parts are physically joined) or Logical (a grouping, e.g. a compound of polymer and filler).

properties.name: assembly_relationship
properties.description: ISA-95 AssemblyRelationship: Permanent (cannot be taken apart again) or Transient (temporary, e.g. a kit).

properties.name: test_specification_ref
properties.description: The TestSpecification (TESTED_BY; ISA-95 MaterialDefinition → TestSpecification). Optional.

properties.name: revision
properties.description: The revision of the article as the source names it — at SAP the suffix of the material number (dddd.1, dddd.2), elsewhere the revision field of the part. Never derived from the number by the model.

properties.name: version
properties.description: The version within a revision (the second axis: iteration or processing state, e.g. A.3 in a PLM). Kept apart from the revision.

properties.name: base_article_ref
properties.description: The article the revisions share (the stem dddd), as the source delivers it or by a rule declared on the source — the model never splits a number.

refStatus.reason: A revision names its stem as a value: there is no stem object the ERP delivers, and B2MML MaterialDefinition has no link between revisions.

properties.name: effective_start
properties.description: From when this article revision is valid (effectivity by date). An effectivity by serial number, lot or unit is no date and has no B2MML field (an extension of its own, PLAN-0700 L5).

properties.name: effective_end
properties.description: Until when this article revision is valid.

properties.name: published_date
properties.description: When this article revision was released by the system that owns it.

properties.name: engineering_change_ref
properties.description: The engineering change (ECN, SAP change number) that released this article revision.

refStatus.reason: Kept as a value: an engineering change is an extension object with no edge into the ISA-95 catalogue.

properties.name: plm_part_ref
properties.description: The part number of this article in PLM (e.g. a Windchill part) where it differs from the ERP number; empty when the source does not name it.

refStatus.reason: Kept as a value: the part lives in PLM; no profile of ours holds it.

relationships.description: The material definitions this article is assembled from (B2MML MaterialDefinition.AssemblyDefinition, ISA-95 Part 2 cl. 5.7); one edge per component, delivered by the source.

constraints.name: stock_below_reorder_level
constraints.description: Stock below the reorder level: the article's available-to-promise stock (free minus reserved) has fallen under the reorder level the ERP article master declares FOR THIS ARTICLE. The IT/planning counterpart to the OT machine bands - a materials-planning finding about an article, not about a machine.

isa95.note: Article / part = ISA-95 MaterialDefinition (Part 2). Physical stock is MaterialLot.
isa95.mappingNote: The unit of a MaterialDefinition sits on its property or quantity in B2MML, not on the definition itself. type, lead time, ABC class, cost, price, currency, stock figures, reorder level and safety stock are ERP article master and inventory fields; B2MML MaterialDefinition has no field for them. PLM model (owner 29.10.2026): the revision is MaterialDefinition.Version; B2MML has one version field, so the second axis version (an iteration within a revision) and base_article_ref (the stem the revisions share) are extensions with no B2MML field. PLM extensions (owner 29.10.2026): engineering_change_ref and plm_part_ref have no B2MML field — B2MML knows no engineering change and no PLM part number next to the material definition.
isa95.grain: one revision of one article (ISA-95 Part 2 MaterialDefinition): one row = one material number as the source delivers it (at SAP dddd.1, dddd.2 — each revision its own number), keyed by article_no; its family is the MaterialClass, its stem base_article_ref
